ticker_news.title: Nebius Group Rally May Be Only Half Over as Meta Deal Fuels Hypergrowth Outlook
ticker_news.description: Nebius Group reported strong Q3 results with 355.1% year-over-year revenue growth, securing a $3 billion contract with Meta that is expected to drive significant future business expansion and potential stock price appreciation.
ticker_news.author: Thomas Hughes

ticker_news.title: How Does Meta Make Money?
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms generates most of its revenue through targeted advertising across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger. The company is heavily investing in AI technologies, creating a new Superintelligence Labs division, and expanding its AI infrastructure while experiencing significant capital expenditures.
ticker_news.author: Rachel Warren
